title: From Observation to Customized Lesson
description: Where the mentor's own observation enters an AI customization loop, and where human review still applies.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: AI-Customized Curriculum and Rolling Out New Agents

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a customization scenario, the learner explains which stage of the loop is mentor observation, which is the AI draft, and which is human review.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin linear loop distinguishing mentor stages from AI stages
pedagogical.assessment: Ask which stages are the mentor's, which is the AI's, and what the AI never sees.
